items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: p0seid0n design tokens: the nine --p0seid0n-* colours, control and panel radii, popup shadow, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge.
items.docs: Import the stylesheet once, in the same file that imports Tailwind. Light and dark follow color-scheme: the OS preference by default, or a .light or .dark class on the html element. There are no dark: variants, so overriding any --p0seid0n-* value re-themes every component, including at runtime.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() class merge helper built on clsx and tailwind-merge.
items.docs: Import cn from your lib alias. It merges conditional classes with clsx and resolves Tailwind conflicts with tailwind-merge.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Ink-filled primary, control-grey secondary, transparent ghost and danger button in three sizes, with loading and leading/trailing slots.
items.docs: Use variant primary, secondary, ghost or danger and size sm, md or lg. Loading sets aria-busy, disables interaction and leaves the progress slot usable. Use the leading and trailing slots for icons; the component ships none. A click handler passed from the parent is not called while loading or disabled.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { buttonVariants } from './variants'
import type { ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from './variants'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type ButtonProps = {
  variant?: ButtonVariant
  size?: ButtonSize
  /** Rendered element or component. Links pass as: 'a'. */
  as?: string | Component
  /** Native button type; ignored when `as` is not a button. */
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
  /** Disables interaction and marks the button as busy. */
  loading?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ButtonProps>(), {
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'md',
  as: 'button',
  type: 'button',
  loading: false,
  disabled: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()

// The click listener is attached by this component so that `loading` and
// `disabled` also block it for non-button roots such as links.
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest.onClick
  return rest
})

const isNativeButton = computed(() => props.as === 'button')
const isInert = computed(() => props.disabled || props.loading)

function onClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
  if (isInert.value) {
    event.preventDefault()
    return
  }
  ;(attrs.onClick as ((event: MouseEvent) => void) | undefined)?.(event)
}
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :type="isNativeButton ? type : undefined"
    :class="cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), $attrs.class as string | undefined)"
    :disabled="isNativeButton ? isInert : undefined"
    :aria-disabled="isInert ? 'true' : undefined"
    :aria-busy="loading ? 'true' : undefined"
    @click="onClick"
  >
    <slot name="progress" />
    <slot name="leading" />
    <slot />
    <slot name="trailing" />
  </component>
</template>

export { default as Button } from './Button.vue'
export { buttonVariants } from './variants'
export type { ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from './variants'
export type { ButtonProps } from './Button.vue'

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: One-pixel rule in a line colour, horizontal or vertical.
items.docs: Set orientation to vertical inside a flex row; the rule stretches to the container height. It is decorative by default and hidden from assistive tech; set decorative to false to expose a separator role.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

export type SeparatorProps = {
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  /** Marks the separator as presentational; it is then hidden from assistive tech. */
  decorative?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SeparatorProps>(), {
  orientation: 'horizontal',
  decorative: true,
})

const isVertical = computed(() => props.orientation === 'vertical')
</script>

<template>
  <div
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'shrink-0 bg-line',
        isVertical ? 'h-full w-px self-stretch' : 'h-px w-full',
        $attrs.class as string | undefined,
      )
    "
    :role="decorative ? 'presentation' : 'separator'"
    :aria-orientation="decorative ? undefined : orientation"
    :aria-hidden="decorative ? 'true' : undefined"
    :data-orientation="orientation"
  />
</template>

export { default as Separator } from './Separator.vue'
export type { SeparatorProps } from './Separator.vue'

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with a focus ring, an aria-driven invalid state and a disabled state.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Set invalid to render aria-invalid and the danger border. Give it an id and point a Label at the same value so the two stay associated.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

export type InputProps = {
  /** Marks the field as invalid and paints the border with the danger colour. */
  invalid?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  id?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<InputProps>(), {
  invalid: false,
  disabled: false,
  id: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string | number>({ default: '' })
const emit = defineEmits<{ input: [event: Event] }>()

function onInput(event: Event): void {
  model.value = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value
  emit('input', event)
}
</script>

<template>
  <input
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :id="id"
    v-model="model"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :aria-invalid="invalid ? 'true' : undefined"
    :class="
      cn(
        'h-11 w-full rounded-control border border-line bg-control px-3 text-[15px] text-ink',
        'placeholder:text-ink-muted',
        'outline-none focus-visible:border-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
        'aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger aria-[invalid=true]:focus-visible:outline-danger',
        'disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-55',
        'transition-[background-color,color,border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none',
        $attrs.class as string | undefined,
      )
    "
    @input="onInput"
  />
</template>

export { default as Input } from './Input.vue'
export type { InputProps } from './Input.vue'

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Two-state control built on reka-ui, in md and lg sizes with an optional slot inside the thumb.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Space and Enter toggle it and aria-checked follows the value. The thumb slot is empty by default so an icon can be passed without adding a dependency. Transitions are dropped under prefers-reduced-motion.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SwitchRoot, SwitchThumb } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

export type SwitchProps = {
  disabled?: boolean
  size?: 'md' | 'lg'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SwitchProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
  size: 'md',
})

const model = defineModel<boolean>({ default: false })
const isLarge = computed(() => props.size === 'lg')
</script>

<template>
  <SwitchRoot
    v-model="model"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border border-line bg-control',
        'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
        'data-[state=checked]:border-ink data-[state=checked]:bg-ink',
        'transition-[background-color,border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none',
        'disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-55',
        isLarge ? 'h-10 w-16 p-0.5' : 'h-7 w-11 p-px',
        $attrs.class as string | undefined,
      )
    "
  >
    <SwitchThumb
      :class="
        cn(
          'pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface text-ink-muted shadow',
          'transition-transform duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none',
          'data-[state=checked]:text-ink',
          isLarge
            ? 'size-8 data-[state=checked]:translate-x-6.5'
            : 'size-6 data-[state=checked]:translate-x-4',
        )
      "
    >
      <slot name="thumb" />
    </SwitchThumb>
  </SwitchRoot>
</template>

export { default as Switch } from './Switch.vue'
export type { SwitchProps } from './Switch.vue'
